# Templates for TestRender_Golden, one per line, with the fictional test
# family of helpers_test.go and the character family. Lines with "#" are
# comments and go into the golden file unchanged.

# B1: a token is "$" with letters, digits and colons; case does not matter
Hello $username!
Hello $UserName, and $USERNAME again.
# B70: punctuation ends a token
($username) $username's turn, $username.
# B1: colons belong to the token; the rest after the identifier stays
$username:$time
# B2, B72: the longest known prefix wins, the rest of the token stays
$usernames $timedigits $timedigitsAgo $timed
$arg1text2 $arg2text
# B32: line break, also as the longest prefix of a longer token
one$linebreaktwo
# B33: characters by decimal number
$unicode937 and $unicode10.
# B71, B7: no escaping; the first "$" of "$$" is text
$$username \$username
# B78: a literal "$" before an identifier name
$unicode36username
# B3: unknown tokens and a lone "$" stay
$unknown, $ alone, $5 and 5$
# B4: identifiers without a value stay
$targetusername $arg3text
# B6, B73: invalid numbers are no match, the token stays
$unicode0 $unicode13 $unicode55296 $unicode1114112 $arg0text
# B23: a failing identifier stays
$followage
